name: Compact Saturated-Tangerine Polycarbonate Smartphone
description: A compact one-hand smartphone with a soft-radius polycarbonate unibody moulded in a single saturated tangerine-orange, a small flat display glass in even black bezels, and a low raised pill housing on the back carrying two stacked camera lenses and one small flash, all in the same tangerine shell.
materials: soft-radius glossy polycarbonate unibody in saturated tangerine-orange, flat black display glass, moulded tangerine camera pill housing with two lens rings
primaryColors: saturated tangerine orange, black display glass
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the polycarbonate shell, camera housing, or bezels, and never render readable interface text, icons, a status bar, a clock, an app grid, or any recognisable operating system on the display; never render a third camera lens, a second flash, a horizontal camera housing, or a visible pixel grid on the display glass; never introduce a second colour, a two-tone panel, a seam, a metal frame rail, or a glass back, and never enlarge the body beyond a compact one-hand size Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the single continuous saturated tangerine polycarbonate unibody with its soft corner radii and seamless colour, the compact one-hand proportions, exactly two stacked lenses and one flash in a single moulded pill housing, one power button and one two-position volume rocker on the right edge only, and the completely plain unmarked back must read identically in every angle, same body size, corner radius and housing position throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
